name: Firoz Shah
role: Mughal prince associated with rebel campaigns
contribution: Firoz Shah was a Mughal prince who joined rebel campaigns during the Indian Rebellion of 1857 and helped connect dynastic claims with resistance to Company rule.
context: His activity belongs to the north and central Indian theatre, where Mughal legitimacy and regional military resistance overlapped during the 1857–1859 conflict.
impact: Firoz Shah represents the lesser-known Mughal and regional princes who participated in the rebellion beyond the symbolic role of Bahadur Shah II.
highlight: Mughal prince associated with rebel campaigns during the 1857 uprising.
seoTitle: Firoz Shah: Mughal Prince in the 1857 Rebellion
seoDescription: Learn about Firoz Shah, the Mughal prince associated with rebel campaigns during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
shortAnswer: Firoz Shah was a Mughal prince who participated in rebel campaigns during the 1857 uprising.

faq.question: Who was Firoz Shah?
faq.answer: He was a Mughal prince associated with rebel campaigns during the 1857 uprising against East India Company rule.
